name: bm-r3-network-expansion-supply
title: Network expansion & collagen supply
claim: The three supply conditions run from a shared initial state; matching the paper's ordering in network area, concentration and connectivity is in progress.
question: Why are both crosslink remodeling and collagen replacement (insertion) necessary for sustained basement-membrane growth?
hypothesis: From identical initial states, no-remodeling, remodeling-without-insertion and remodeling- with-insertion diverge in network area, collagen concentration and integrity in the direction and ordering of Figure 2B-C: only remodeling with supply sustains growth without loss of the largest connected network.
objective: From identical initial states, compare no remodeling, remodeling without insertion, and remodeling with insertion under matched forcing; measure area expansion, collagen density and largest-connected-network size; match the direction and ordering of Fig 2B-C.
description:
Reproduces the supply/loss/dilution decomposition of Barrientos Fig 2B-C. Three matched
conditions share one initial state and forcing; the readouts are network area expansion,
collagen concentration and connectivity (largest connected component). The study establishes
which combination of remodeling and insertion sustains a growing network, a prerequisite for
the growth-rheology coupling used by R4 and the perturbations in R6.

expected_behavior.name: supply-ordering-matches-fig2bc
expected_behavior.rationale: Matching Fig 2B-C ordering and direction across the three conditions is the success criterion; absolute values are secondary to the ordering.

baseline.name: bm-r3-network-expansion-supply
baseline.note: Uses the collagen IV network model, with the loading protocol and the readouts matched to the paper's measurements.

config.title: Supply vs remodelling (small real run)
config.caption: A small REAL collagen run contrasting remodelling (make+break) vs make-only - the ordering behind 'supply sustains growth'. Full Fig 2B-C reproduction is the study target.
